name: Moonlighting
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Az McCaffrey: Mechanical Prodigy, Downfall's Criminal identity, whose first job resource, connection resource or piece of hardware installed each turn is a credit cheaper. On Picket Line's frame, its identity swapped: Red Team a job; Smartware Distributor, Debbie “Downtown” Moreira and Hannah “Wheels” Pilintra connections; Docklands Pass, Pennyshaver, T400 Memory Diamond, Capybara and Zenit Chip JZ-2MJ hardware; and two Isolation for its two Strike Fund, seven credits for a resource the deck has already cashed. Picket Line keeps every card given up here. Downfall Stage 3: two Masterwork (v37) for two Pennyshaver, a console that draws on the turn's first hardware and installs another as a run begins for a credit more. Downfall Stage 5: two “Baklan” Bochkin for two Red Team, a connection Az discounts that loads a power counter on each run's first encounter and trades itself and a tag for a derez of ice no stronger than its counters; Red Team is in nine other decks. Downfall Stage 7: two The Class Act for its two Verbal Plasticity, a connection that draws 4 the turn it is installed and looks past the top of the stack before each turn's first draw.
